text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... Maruzen! Are you free tomorrow?!
If you
are... w-would you like to hang
out with me to
play another game?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I have time... but you look rather
pale,
Chiyo. Aren't you tired?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we leave the games for
another time?
You should probably get
some—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No need! I'm overflowing with energy!
So... please
look forward to tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah... Chiyo! I hope she's okay...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the designated meeting spot
to find a
crowd already waiting.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What's all this about, Chiyo? There's a...
lot of
paper strewn around.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
We planned a fun activity to thank you
for
everything! It was Chiyo's idea!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
You have to shoot at the paper tassels
with these
water guns! And once you do,
there will be a
raffle number waiting for
you underneath the
target.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
These numbers are hidden all over! Try
to find as
many as you can, okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, an activity to thank me? Raffle?
H-hold on a
second, what is going—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Why not give it a go first? Learning is all
about
doing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Uh, what?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky uncharacteristically panics
at first.
But as she gradually grasps the
situation, she gets
back to her normal
self.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
I got a three! Let's see... I have to sing
my favorite
song a cappella?! Th-that's
so embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Then, I'll clap a beat for you. ♪
Come on,
show me how hip and groovy
you can get!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Number nine! Oh, I won a juice box! On
to the
next target.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you've got some competition,
missy! Time
to aim and... shoot!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I got number one! So, what do I
win? Hehe,
this is so exciting.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You win... a tickle punishment!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What?! But I got a one?! Eek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of laughter fills the air. With
the game
having no clear winner,
everyone is free to enjoy
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely get a good one next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Sakura Chiyono O's idea has
gone
exactly to plan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was a blast! Thanks a lot,
Chiyo! But
what's all this about thanking
me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're always looking out for us.
So that's
why...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I wanted you to enjoy yourself for a
change! I
know it sounds a little childish,
but I...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Chiyo... So that's what you've been
thinking
this whole time. Is that why
you've been so busy
lately?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well a lot of that was me fumbling
around! But
all the running I got to do
was just as fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I kept thinking about what would make
you
happy and how your smile would
look. I couldn't
stop myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And then... your reaction was so much
better than
I had imagined! Thank you
so much, Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I hope I get to see you smile like you did
today
more and more!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm so grateful, Chiyo! And you're right. I
should
probably let others be caring
towards me more
often!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-any time you want! Just say the word...
I'm more
than happy to oblige!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The raffle target game was a big
success...
Oh! Look, there's still one left.
Do you want to
shoot it down, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Sakura Chiyono O's gaze to the
remaining
target in question. After I
shoot it down...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... You got number nineteen!
That's a
good one! Your prize is a
piggyback ride home!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hold on a second. I wanted to thank
you too,
Trainer! So instead of a
piggyback...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You can hop in my ride! I'm ready to hit
the gas!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The journey back is a wild one, a
reflection of
how much Maruzensky
enjoyed today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's see, you got a number... Pfft! Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! Hehe... Get ready,
Trainer. ♪
...Because you're in for a
chase!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Take this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O and Maruzensky fire
their
water guns, drenching me from
head to toe...
